events.content:
Built a small Reading Shelf app. The home page separates books into **Currently reading** and **Finished**. You can add a title, author, and notes; mark a book finished; and open its detail page to view its notes and copy a link.

Books persist in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json). Run the app with `npm start`; it serves at `http://localhost:3000`.
